answer.answer: The Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U) helps city households across officially defined lower and middle income bands obtain permanent homes [E02]. Launched on 25th June 2015 by the Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs, it provides pucca houses to eligible urban households in the EWS (Economically Weaker Section), LIG (Low Income Group), and MIG (Middle Income Group) categories [E01][E02]. The scheme covers all statutory towns and notified urban areas and includes components like the Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) offering interest subsidies on housing loans [E02].

claim_to_evidence.claim: PMAY-U was launched on 25th June 2015 to provide pucca houses to eligible urban households
The scheme addresses urban housing for EWS, LIG, and MIG categories
The scheme covers all statutory towns and notified urban areas
The scheme includes Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) offering interest subsidies on housing loans
